name: Merge Up

features.name: Merging gems
features.description: Winning clusters merge into higher-level symbols that can merge again.

features.name: Cell multipliers
features.description: Free spins wins generate cell multipliers.

review:
Merge Up introduced BGaming's merging mechanic on a 6x6 cascade grid. Gem symbols come in different levels. Winning clusters pay and then merge into higher-level gems, which can merge again, creating chain reactions where symbols upgrade step by step.

When merging reaches the top level, it produces a scatter, and scatters can also simply drop onto the grid. Four or more scatters trigger free spins, in which winning clusters generate cell multipliers. A bonus buy is available where permitted. BGaming designed the merging so the base game feels rewarding on its own rather than just a wait for the bonus. It's rated very high volatility with a 5,000x maximum, and the 97.25% RTP is one of the highest in our database.
pros: Excellent 97.25% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
